task: Swipe the large Sunshower product photo to the next or previous image while keeping the selected thumbnail synchronized

identityBeforeWrite.method: Reused draft first synchronized to fresh MAIN, then renamed before feature writes

implementation.gesture: PointerEvents on the fixed large-photo button; left selects next and right selects previous. At least 40px horizontal motion and horizontal distance greater than 1.25 times vertical distance; one image per gesture, bounded ends without wrap.
implementation.scrollAndZoom: Only photo button uses touch-action: pan-y pinch-zoom. Vertical movement, additional pointers, pointercancel and lost capture cancel navigation. Native image dragging disabled. Motion of at least 12px suppresses the resulting zoom click; the next deliberate pointerdown or keyboard activation can open zoom.
implementation.selection: Swipe and thumbnail requests use the same existing loaded/decoded Image-node commit and single selected-thumbnail update. Desired cursor is separate from committed selection so fast gestures can advance during loading. Latest failure resets desired cursor to committed selection; earlier failure cannot undo a newer request.
implementation.preservation: Existing load/decode/intent/detached-node guards and init/load/persisted-pageshow restore paths retained. Thumbnail reveal scrolls only the horizontal thumbnail strip, never scrollIntoView or page scroll.

behavior.method: Dependency-free controlled event doubles; separate from native browser input

patch.limits: This verifies a two-file source patch against the supplied two-file baseline. It does not verify Shopify theme roles, deployment, browser behavior, remote Git storage, cart persistence or checkout.

desktop.method: Actual Shopify preview product page with native browser mouse drags

mobileComponent.method: Componentfixture using exact final production gallery block, actual CSS and five real photos; native browser mouse drags at narrow widths, no physical touchscreen

tests.temporaryQa: Existing templates/page.bc-mobile-qa.liquid restored byte-exact to baseline after checks

screenshot.scope: Narrow componentfixture in cloud browser, not a physical phone

git.delivery: Production source retained as applicable patch; no theme source paths pushed

nextAction: Owner reviews BadkamerCity - Sunshower swipen on phone and decides whether to publish
rollback: Do not publish preview; after publication restore only baseline assets/bc-sunshower-page.js and assets/bc-sunshower-configurator.css, or use the previous theme only if no later changes exist.
